---
title: "Package Overview"
---

This section describes the main modules and classes in the
`spatial_guidance` Python package.
See also the [Class Overview](classes.qmd) for a list of all classes.

## `data_contracts`

Defines Pydantic data models that structure detections and datasets.
Key classes include `RawAABBDetSeg` for axis-aligned bounding boxes,
`RawOBBDetection` for oriented boxes and `DatasetOut` for dataset
metadata.

## `data_handling`

Utilities for loading datasets. `StrayDataset` wraps StrayScanner data
and applies scaling and pose normalization.

## `live_agent`

An asynchronous actor that streams frames and user prompts to Gemini
models. `GeminiLiveAgent` manages the event loop, audio streaming and
response buffering. Commands and events are defined in
`actor_protocols.py`.

## `scene_understanding`

Wrappers around the Gemini vision API for obtaining 2D/3D detections and
scene descriptions from images.

## `visualization`

Helper classes for drawing detections on RGB/depth images using
`matplotlib` and `PIL`.

## `ui`

A minimal Streamlit application to run the live agent from the browser.

## `utils`

Configuration, logging helpers and path handling utilities used
throughout the code base.
